about_the_game:
Ai Chan is a Windows and MacOS assistant and conversational AI powered by OpenAI's Chat GPT and Whisper.
You need an OpenAI API Key to use this App.
*) This is unofficial OpenAI's app.
*) Please refer to the guide provided when starting the App for the first time.

You can talk or chat with Ai Chan on any topic you like, whether studying, joking, common knowledge, or even a specific conversation topic like programming. You can also execute simple commands like opening and closing apps (notepad, chrome, paint, etc.), opening websites (social medial, video streaming site, etc.), and other basic commands like restarting and shutting down your PC.

Ai Chan supports multiple languages from around the world.
When you activate voice mode (it'll consume in-app coins), the App will reply with voice when possible.
You can also customize the voice and the clothes as you like.

You can buy coins from the in-app store.
